model.name: Drawer interaction: grab-bar mouse parity + X-minimize
model.description: Extends the R22.2 touch-first mouse-parity principle to the drawer CHROME (not just pan/zoom content): the grab-bar must respond to mouse drag for resize/dismiss (currently touch-only), and the X button must collapse the drawer to a MINIMIZED peek state (not full close/hide) on both touch and mouse.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (drawer): the drawer grab-bar must work the same with mouse as touch, and the X button should collapse the drawer to a minimized peek state (not close it entirely), on both touch and mouse.

discoverySource.note: BUG2 grab-bar mouse-drag missing + BUG3 X-should-minimize-not-close; not covered by R22/R25; architect recommended ONE new req sibling to R22.2. PO confirmed R25.4 with these 2 ACs.

model.siblingNote: Sibling of R22.2 (touch-first mouse-parity). R22.2 covers drawer pan/zoom CONTENT; R25.4 covers the drawer CHROME (grab-bar drag + X-minimize). R22.2.refinedBy points here.
model.refinementOfNote: Refines the R22.2 'works the same way with mouse' principle onto the drawer chrome. The brief AC-grab on R22.2 was backed out in favour of this dedicated req (single-source).
model.implRef: ior:file:src/public/ts/trace/rb-detail-drawer.ts (grab-bar touch handlers lines 38-40, touch-only; X button calls close() which hides entirely - needs minimize()/peek)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The drawer grab-bar responds to mousedown/mousemove/mouseup for resize/dismiss - mirroring touch (currently touch-only; rb-detail-drawer.ts lines 38-40).
The X button collapses the drawer to a MINIMIZED (peek) state - NOT a full close/hide - on both touch AND mouse click (today X calls close() which hides entirely; needs a minimize()/peek state).
